sources.title: PLD — Product Liability Directive (software & AI)
sources.why: Governs liability when an app, SaMD or AI model causes physical harm, the core adverse-effect concern of this dimension.

sources.title: Combination products device + medicine (MDR Art. 1(8)/1(9), Art. 117)
sources.why: Apps that set drug doses or drive adherence carry contraindication and drug-interaction risks central to adverse effects.

sources.title: SaMD Class IIb (MDR)
sources.why: Classifies software by harm severity, where missed alerts or dosing errors can cause death or irreversible adverse effects.
